proposed_composition.reply:
For most people, Medicare first becomes available around age 65. The usual first sign-up window is 7 months long: the 3 months before your 65th birthday month, your birthday month, and the 3 months after. That said, the sign-up window and the date coverage actually starts are not always the same thing, and your current insurance can affect which timing rules matter.

So the most useful next detail is what coverage you have now, because that helps us sort out whether you may need to act around 65 or whether other timing rules could apply.
proposed_composition.question: What health insurance do you have now?
